l0_microbenchmark.conclusion: host native implementation leverages dedicated hardware instruction npu_moe_gating_top_k (CANN fused softmax+topk) and specialized coprocessor npu_moe_init_routing_v2 (hardware token permute and expert token counter); software Triton or composite PyTorch implementation suffers from sorting and scatter overhead on Vector Core, yielding negative speedup vs CANN instruction
l0_microbenchmark.measurement: NPU graph, 20 repetitions packed per replay, single 910B2

l4_attribution.note: rejected due to negative speedup against CANN dedicated npu_moe_gating_top_k / npu_moe_init_routing_v2; retained as negative benchmark reference
